Braum|sup.identity: Protective tank. Concussive Blows (passive): his attacks apply stacks; once the first is applied, his allies' attacks apply them too, and at 4 stacks the target is stunned. Winter's Bite (Q) throws ice that slows and applies a stack, Stand Behind Me (W) leaps him to an ally (both gain armor and magic resist), Unbreakable (E) raises his shield in a direction to destroy every projectile that hits it, and Glacial Fissure (R) knocks up enemies in a line and leaves a fissure that slows.
Braum|sup.playstyle: Protection and counter-engage support: he blocks projectiles, stuns with his passive and protects his ADC. No clearly unfavorable matchups: his worst ones (Senna, Zilean, Rell) stay close to even. He crushes melee supports and hooks (Blitzcrank, Nautilus).
Braum|sup.early_game: At level 1, Q then attacks: with your ADC, the passive stuns quickly. Keep E to block the enemy hook, anchor or big poke. W lets you reach your ADC instantly.
Braum|sup.level_1: Winter's Bite (Q) first. Q, then attacks with your ADC to stun.
Braum|sup.level_2: Unbreakable (E). Blocks hooks and projectiles: your ADC stays behind you.
Braum|sup.level_3: Stand Behind Me (W). Leap to your ADC when they're engaged on, then use E to cover them.
Braum|sup.level_6: Glacial Fissure: a knock-up in a line, then a slow. Use it to engage on both opponents or stop an enemy engage.
power_spikes: Levels 1 to 2: passive stun with your ADC.
First resistance items: a very durable shield.
Teamfights: E in front of your carry, R on divers.
Braum|sup.lane_plan: Trade at levels 1 and 2 with your passive, and protect your ADC from engages with E. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored): control vision at dragon.
Braum|sup.trading: Basic trade: Q, attacks with your ADC for the stun. Defense: W to your ADC, E facing the enemy. All-in: Q, attacks, R on both opponents. Against supports who poke without blockable projectiles (Zilean), play for engages instead.
threats: Senna, Zilean and Rell: your worst matchups, close to even.
Area or non-projectile damage, which your shield doesn't block.
Kiting: you need to be close to apply your passive.
mistakes: Raising your shield in the wrong direction.
Using W to engage and no longer being able to reach your ADC.
Casting your ultimate without your team ready to follow.

matchup_notes.Nautilus: E blocks his anchor; if he engages, W to your ADC, then R.
matchup_notes.Blitzcrank: Block his hook with E, or let him grab you instead.
matchup_notes.Leona: She engages you: answer with W to your ADC and your passive.
matchup_notes.Senna: She pokes you from far away: block her Q's with E and engage on her when she steps up.

Braum|sup.mid_game: Stick with your ADC and jungler. Place Control Wards and protect objectives.
Braum|sup.late_game: Stay in front of your carry, E facing the enemy team, W to reach them, R on divers or to engage on a group.
Braum|sup.ahead: Engage with R and help your team take objectives.
Braum|sup.behind: Protect your ADC: your shield and ultimate cancel engages.
Braum|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to protect your carry with your shield and win fights thanks to your passive's stun.
Braum|sup.final_tip: The first stack comes from you, the rest from your team: Q or an attack on the target, then let your ADC finish the stun.
